summary: Elme Communities filed an 8-K (Items 1.02, 2.01, 9.01) disclosing the sale of Riverside Apartments and termination of its Goldman Sachs $520M senior secured term loan. Proceeds from the disposition repaid the loan, leaving approximately $198.6M outstanding prior to closing. The loan was collateralized by ten properties, including Riverside, Bethesda, Germantown and Watergate 600, with a November 2026 maturity and one-year extension option. The sale follows the November 2025 disposition of 19 multifamily assets to Cortland Partners. Watch for remaining asset sale proceeds and potential further deleveraging or strategic actions.
